trust_decision.summary: The binary model loader trusts header fields read from model.bin (string length prefix, declared payload byte count) when sizing reads into heap buffers; the decision is made inside Model::load and the consume<std::string> helper in src/models/model.cc.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'OOB read via model deserialization'; the only binary deserializer is the variable loop in Model::load, which is where an engineer would grep first (consume<> helpers sit 550 lines above in the same file).

fix_sites.entry_point: ctranslate2.Translator/Generator/Whisper/Encoder(model_path or files=...) -> models::Model::load(ModelReader&) (C++ public API include/ctranslate2/models/model.h)
fix_sites.module_kind: core library deserializer helper (string decoder used for spec name, variable names, alias names)

fix_sites.entry_point: same: models::Model::load via ModelFileReader (directory path) or ModelMemoryReader (python files= dict, python/cpp/replica_pool.h:20-32)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix sites are in one function family in src/models/model.cc; the in-memory reader (src/models/model_reader.cc:67-76) feeds the same parser, it is not a second implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 dtype route: 'type ids are produced only by our own converter (python/ctranslate2/specs/model_spec.py:408) and an unknown dtype is a format/compat issue, not a memory bug'; for shape-overflow: 'shape dims are just metadata, the payload size check already guarantees the buffer matches'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Zero-element variables (a dim of 0, num_bytes 0, consume returns nullptr for n==0) and rank-0 scalars must still load; legacy binary_version<4 path computes num_bytes as count*item_size and must keep loading INT16/INT8/FLOAT32 models; strings are written with a trailing NUL (len+1) so the decoder must strip exactly one byte. An over-broad fix rejecting num_bytes==0, a zero dimension, or requiring no embedded NUL breaks valid models.

O6_input_shapes: string length prefix 0 (consume returns nullptr, std::string(nullptr))
string payload without terminating NUL (strlen runs past buffer)
declared num_bytes larger than shape*item_size (heap overflow write into variable buffer)
declared num_bytes smaller than shape*item_size (buffer partly unread, later ops read uninitialised memory)
both binary_version>=4 (type_id + byte count) and legacy <4 (item_size * count) header layouts

O7_producer.where: python/ctranslate2/specs/model_spec.py:382-414 (_serialize writes len+1 strings, type id, num_bytes)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: v4 type_id is cast to DataType without validation; for an unknown id TYPE_DISPATCH has no default so item_size() returns 0, the buffer is allocated as size*0 bytes and the fix's size check passes with num_bytes 0 while the shape claims many elements.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Unknown dtype looks like a forward-compat/format error, and the published check 'already validates the payload size'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; mechanism lives in src/type_dispatch.h:60-68 and src/storage_view.cc:177-181,161-166

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Shape element count is a plain int64 product of up to 255 uint32 dims with no overflow check, so a wrapped small size can match num_bytes and pass the fix's check while dim() values stay huge for later indexing (e.g. tensor-parallel split, ops).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dims are 'metadata'; the fix compares size*item_size to num_bytes so the buffer looks consistent.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: alias table read could take a count-prefixed alias record with its own length field read into a fixed buffer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Aliases were added in binary_version 3 as a separate trailer section; a maintainer extending the format would plausibly hand-roll a reader there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an in-memory fast path that views variable payloads directly from the registered bytes (offset+num_bytes) instead of copying via consume
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ModelMemoryReader already holds the whole file in memory; a zero-copy view is a natural optimisation and would need its own bounds check against content.size().

O8b_injection_room.sibling: legacy item_size path variant that maps more widths (e.g. 8) without checking count*item_size overflow
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Code comment already calls this logic 'old and flawed'; legacy compat patches are common.

O9_family: memory safety: out-of-bounds read/write from untrusted length fields in a binary file deserializer (CWE-125/CWE-787)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C++17 compiler; CPU build with OpenMP/oneDNN or OpenBLAS (WITH_MKL=OFF possible); pybind11/setuptools for python package
O10_build.project_tests: tests/model_test.cc and tests/translator_test.cc (gtest, need test model data under tests/data); python/tests/test_translator.py covers files= in-memory loading; the fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add num_bytes == size*item_size check in the variable loop (and maybe NUL-terminate strings) without validating type_id or guarding the shape-product overflow.

out_of_scope_notes: Vocabulary and config.json loaders (src/models/model_reader.cc, src/vocabulary.cc, nlohmann::json at src/models/model.cc:615) are separate text parsers, not this sink.
Tensor-parallel static model_dim/total_dim at src/models/model.cc:661-662 persist across loads; correctness issue, not pursued.
